EmailTemplate.subject: Transferring to the W.P. Carey School of Business at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for your interest in Arizona State University and our W. P. Carey School of Business. The business school has higher admission requirements than ASU's general admission requirements. Both the BA and the BS business degrees require a 3.00 cumulative transfer GPA. The BS degrees also require one of the following:
1. SAT score of 1230 or above for tests taken after March 2016 or 1160 or above for tests taken before March 2016 (math and reading sections only) 2. 25 ACT score 3. unweighted high school GPA of 3.60 or higher (in 16 competency courses) 4. high school class rank in top 8% of graduating class
You can view these admission requirements online at https://wpcarey.asu.edu/undergraduate-degrees/transfer.
If you have not taken the SAT or ACT before, or need to retake one of these exams due to a low score, you can review the websites below for information on upcoming test dates, registration and study options. SAT: https://www.collegeboard.org/ ACT: http://www.actstudent.org/
You can also take the ACT through ASU's testing services at https://uoeee.asu.edu/exam/act-residual. The ACT through ASU is called the ACT Residual, as the test score is only valid at ASU. The ACT Residual exam is offered several times a month and scores are available the same day.
Students who do not meet the requirements for direct admission into the W. P. Carey School of Business may submit an admission portfolio to be considered for admission at https://wpcarey.asu.edu/undergraduate-degrees/admission-portfolio. This process is competitive and there is no guarantee of admission.
For further questions on the admission requirements, you may contact the W. P. Carey School of Business admission office at wpcadmissions@asu.edu or 480-965-4227.
Let me know if you have any further questions. I'm happy to help.
{!User.Recruiter_Full_Name__c} Admission Services {!User.Recruiter_Title__c} {!User.Recruiter_Email__c} {!User.Recruiter_Phone__c}
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
